title: Honor explicit temperature in local GGUF inference
context: LocalModelProviderAdapter forwards the requested temperature into LocalModelGenerationRequest, but LlamaCPPModelEngine always samples greedily and ignores it. This silently violates the local inference request contract when callers explicitly configure temperature.
goal: Honor a valid explicit temperature with a request-scoped llama.cpp temperature/distribution sampler while preserving greedy output for unspecified or non-positive temperatures.
forbidden_changes: Do not change the default deterministic behavior when temperature is unspecified.
Do not change model loading, context size, or GPU residency policy.
Do not expose or persist prompt contents or user data.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit finite positive temperature selects a request-scoped temperature plus distribution sampler.
Unspecified, zero, negative, or non-finite temperature retains the existing greedy sampler.
Temperature is bounded to a safe sampler range.
Request-scoped sampler is freed on success, error, and cancellation.
Regression tests cover normalization/bounds; M3 and Apple Native Build compile the native path.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
recovery: Revert the single task commit if native sampler lifecycle or deterministic default behavior regresses.
